key_insight: Crab is a semantics-aware checkpoint/restore runtime that records only the agent-visible semantics and the OS artifacts they affect, enabling correct per-turn snapshots with orders-of-magnitude less cost than full VM/container snapshots.
problem_solved: Existing approaches either restore only application-level state (losing OS-side effects) or take full per-turn snapshots (accurate but prohibitively expensive under dense co-location). This prevents efficient, correct rollback/branching, fault tolerance, and scalable RL rollouts for sandboxed autonomous agents.
method: Semantics-aware interception: instrument agent runtimes and key syscalls to map high-level agent actions to the precise filesystem, process and runtime artifacts they touch.

Selective incremental C/R: capture fine-grained diffs (files, memory regions, process descriptors, runtime artifacts) and store them with copy-on-write/deduplication to minimize snapshot size and I/O.

Fast restore + sandbox integration: rehydrate consistent agent-visible state quickly inside containers/microVMs, using shared backing and isolation primitives to support dense co-location and fast branching/rollback.
impact: Provides low-overhead, correct per-turn checkpoints so practitioners can run scalable RL rollouts, safe experimentation, fault-tolerant services, and cheap branching/rollback for autonomous agents in containerized or microVM environments.
visual_elements: Architecture diagram: agent sandbox + Crab layer showing interception points (runtime, syscalls) and what artifacts are captured (files, memory, processes).
Cost vs correctness chart: three curves comparing app-level recovery (cheap, incomplete), full per-turn snapshot (correct, expensive), and Crab (correct, low cost).
Per-turn timeline: sequence of agent turns with small delta snapshots and fast branch/restore arrows illustrating rollouts and rollback.
Icon set / legend: container, microVM, snapshot/diff, branching icon to quickly convey targets and use-cases.
paper_title: Crab: A Semantics-Aware Checkpoint/Restore Runtime for Agent Sandboxes
paper_authors: Tianyuan Wu, Chaokun Chang, Lunxi Cao, Wei Gao, Wei Wang
